name: Chantress
subtitle: Ritual Singer
description: Awaken your allies from their slumber and enhances their divinity generation.
lore: These priestesses of Hathor are ritual singers, their voices granted power through long practice and mystical tattoos on their bodies. In days of old, their songs were meant only for religious ceremony and perhaps the recording of history or doctrine, but now it grants them a degree of genuine magical ability, which they use in both administration and war.
divinity_generator: Gain [50] Divinity when an ally uses an Ultimate ability.

skills.name: Festive Liturgy
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 170%ATK, then increase the Divinity of this hero by 5%.

skills.name: Awaken the Gods
skills.description: Increase the Divinity of all allies by 100 then has a 25% chance to remove [Sleep] from all allies.
